# OpenCode Frontend Toolbox

> Preferred tools for UI/frontend work. Pick the row matching the task, then open its canonical page.

## Tools

- [MDXCN](https://www.mdxcn.dev/llms.txt): authoring Markdown / MDX
- [Numbers](https://numbers.sfinterface.com/): displaying numbers, stats, metrics
- [VoidAuth](https://voidauth.app/): adding authentication
- [Kugiri](https://edoardolunardi.github.io/kugiri/): animating text appearance
- [Component Gallery](https://component.gallery/components/): choosing UI wording, components, patterns
- [SVGL](https://svgl.app/): adding logos / brand marks
- [ShadScan](https://www.shadscan.com/docs): auditing a shadcn/ui codebase
- [env.style](https://www.env.style/): local deployment / environment config
- [shieldcn](https://shieldcn.dev/docs): writing a README
